basics.name: Natnael Bekele Haile
basics.label: Fullstack Software Engineer & AI Systems Developer
basics.summary: Fullstack (backend-heavy) software engineer with extensive experience in building scalable investment management platforms, AI-driven analytics, and LLM fine-tuning/RLHF pipelines. Competitive programming coach with a proven record of mentoring 500+ engineers, with 80+ landing roles at Google, Amazon, Bloomberg, and top tech companies.

work.name: Vula
work.summary: Engineering end-to-end investment management and portfolio tracking platforms.
highlights: Architected an end-to-end investment management platform featuring automated pre-investment tracking to streamline due diligence and initial vetting processes.
Implemented AI-driven analytics for post-investment tracking, providing real-time visibility into asset performance and financial outcomes for international portfolios.

work.name: Turing
work.summary: Trained and benchmarked state-of-the-art Large Language Models.
highlights: Designed and validated multi-domain tasks (Networking, Python, Data Science) to train LLMs via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and RLHF methodologies.
Created robust unit testing frameworks to evaluate model-generated code against ideal solutions, ensuring high-fidelity output.

work.name: Africa to Silicon Valley (A2SV, Backed by Google)
work.summary: Directed competitive programming squads and coached top engineering students across Ethiopia.
highlights: Led an education squad (consisting of 6 heads of education), teaching 500+ students over two cohorts from AAU (2 classes in 2023, 4 classes in 2024), ASTU (1 class in 2023, 4 classes in 2024) & AASTU (2 classes in 2024).
Contributed to 80+ students securing internships and new grad offers from top tech companies, including Google, Amazon, Bloomberg, and more.
Final year project: mBERT-based Hate Speech Classification for Amharic Language

projects.name: The Geometry of Dormant Defection (Latent Sleeper Agent Linear Probes)
